grid.ctx_sizing: b11819 has no -c flag: ctx auto = n_prompt + n_gen + n_depth = S+64 (llama-bench.cpp line ~1308); the depth prefix is built outside the timing window

metrics.primary: Pure decode TPS after a prefix of length S: the `tg64 @ d{S}` row in the table (t/s ± std, r=3). Mechanism — `-d/--n-depth`: depth tokens are prefilled outside the measurement (llama_memory_clear + restore cstate/test_prompt, b11819 lines 2447-2514), timing starts afterwards; tg64 = 64 decode tokens. Exactly one row per cell.
metrics.why_not_pp_plus_tg: t/s of the combined pp{S}+tg{n} row = (n_prompt+n_gen)/t_total: at large S prefill dominates → the row measures prompt speed, not decode TPS; unsuitable as an E1 metric (discovered from source after the 23:29 abort).
metrics.secondary: cell exit code + OOM text in the raw file = boundary data for 'when KV becomes a problem'

measured_oom_boundary_f16.result: No OOM anywhere, including f16 @ S=32768 (run of 2026-10-23)
measured_oom_boundary_f16.S_32768: KV f16 ≈ 832 MiB: only the 8 global layers grow linearly with S (s_grow = 16,384 B/position); the SWA window of the 40 local layers is bounded by min(S,1024) — b11819 allocates a ring buffer
measured_oom_boundary_f16.note: the earlier OOM expectation was based on an inverted architecture (C-10, corrected 2026-10-23)

kv_elems_per_token.note: linear part = the 8 global full layers only: s = 8·(2·512)·e → f16 = 16,384 B/position; q8_0 (e=34/32) = 8,704; q4_0 (e=18/32) = 4,608 (see inference_math.py)
kv_elems_per_token.swa_note: SWA window (40 local layers, window 1024) — constant c_swa: f16 = 3.355e8 B/token; q8_0 = 1.783e8; q4_0 = 9.437e7
